subject: ggplot minor ticks on logarithmic axis

messages.author: db320aef0eceecf2
messages.subject: ggplot minor ticks on logarithmic axis
parts:
Hi,
I am sure someone can help me.
I would like to add minor tick marks along the y-axis in a logarithmic
plot. In the example below, I would like to have minor tick marks
(about half the size of the major tick marks) at 2*10^3, 3*10^3,
4*10^3 etc.
I would not like to add minor grid lines but only little tick marks. I
tried with scale_y_continuous but did not have any success.

Thanks a lot for your help!
Thomas

a <- seq(from=10,to=1000,by=10)^2
b <-log10(a)

dat <-data.frame(b,a)
p<-ggplot(dat,aes(x=b,y=a))
p+geom_point()+scale_y_log10()
